newsitem.title: USA: Stray bullet kills mother and child in Los Angeles.
newsitem.headline: Stray bullet kills mother and child in Los Angeles.

text.p: A stray bullet believed to have been fired by a gang member pierced the wall of a home more than 100 yards (meters) away and killed a mother and her young daughter, police said on Friday.

Los Angeles County Sheriff's Deputy Debra Glafkides said the 28-year-old mother was watching television in the living room and her three-year-old daughter was playing on the floor nearby on Thursday night when the bullet, fired from a high-powered assault rifle, pierced the wall and struck them both.
Police called the freak nature of their deaths -- a single bullet killing two people who were about three feet (one meter) apart -- "extremely tragic" The victims were not immediately identified.

Glafkides said witnesses told detectives they saw a car drive up to an intersection about 110 yards (meters) from the house. Two men got out of the car and started firing at another man standing near the intersection in an apparent gang-related shooting. The man who was the target was not hit, police said.
"One of the bullets went astray and hit the house where the mother and her daughter were," Glafkides said.
After the shooting, the gunmen got into their car and left, the deputy said, adding that no arrests had yet been made.
